name: Interactive Brokers
label: Interactive Brokers — IBKR Web API / Client Portal API
description: Official IBKR Web API / Client Portal API. Docs: https://www.interactivebrokers.com/campus/ibkr-api-page/webapi-doc/. One node; operations via `operation`. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node. Regulated brokerage. Official Client Portal Gateway or Web API OAuth 2 only. DO NOT BUILD unofficial gateways or TWS socket as this HTTP node. Market-data licenses apply. Not investment advice. Customer needs IBKR API agreement.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields for Interactive Brokers. Secrets never on this port.

schema.label: Operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. EXACT: account_summary | place_order | cancel_order | positions | market_data | trigger. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP.

schema.label: Base Url
schema.description: Client Portal Gateway or api.ibkr.com host origin including path prefix. Example: https://localhost:5000/v1/api.

schema.label: accountId
schema.description: URL path parameter `accountId` for operations: place_order, cancel_order, positions. Required by: place_order, cancel_order, positions.

schema.label: orders
schema.description: place_order body.orders — list of {conid, orderType, side, tif, quantity, price?}. EXACT orderType: MKT | LMT | STP | STP_LIMIT | MIDPRICE. side: BUY | SELL. tif: DAY | GTC | IOC | OPG. The engine cannot flatten a single order (orders is an array). Example: [{"conid":265598,"orderType":"MKT","side":"BUY","tif":"DAY","quantity":1}].

schema.label: orderId
schema.description: URL path parameter `orderId` for operation: cancel_order. Required by: cancel_order.

schema.label: fields
schema.description: market_data query fields — comma-separated IBKR field ids (e.g. 31,84,86). Example: 31,84.

ports.name: output
ports.description: OfficialApiNode result: {status,http_status,data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. Never secrets or PAN.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb to run. EXACT: account_summary | place_order | cancel_order | positions | market_data | trigger. Default account_summary. operation=trigger is kind:ingress — it does not open a socket. Use a BPMN message start / catch / boundary event; StudioQuack webhook ingress correlates onto those events. There is no Webhook node.

configurationParameters.label: Default account
configurationParameters.description: Default IBKR accountId when INPUT is empty (place_order / cancel_order / positions).

configurationParameters.label: Base Url
configurationParameters.description: Client Portal Gateway or api.ibkr.com host origin including path prefix. Example: https://localhost:5000/v1/api.
